title: Health Connect
summary: Exercise sessions and day metrics read on-device from Android Health Connect.

requirements.text: Exercise sessions are read from Health Connect at app start, on resume, on pull-to-refresh and from Settings, with calories and average heart rate.

history.text: Exercise sessions are read from Health Connect on every app start and on demand from Settings, with calories, distance and average heart rate.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: it also runs on resume and refresh, and distance is kept only in the description.

requirements.text: Health Connect is read on the device, without a network request, and only records written by the Garmin Connect app are read.

history.text: Health Connect is read entirely on the device; no Garmin account or cloud service is involved.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: only Garmin Connect's records are read.

requirements.text: On desktop, Health Connect is absent and its commands do nothing.
